credentials.description: API key, sent as `x-key`. Required unless `apiKey` or `apiKeyProvider` is set in settings.
Fallback API key, read when `BFL_API_KEY` is not set.

notes: FLUX image generation and editing and FLUX 3 video generation from Black Forest Labs. Jobs are submitted and polled until the result is ready; the request protocol and available options depend on the model family.
